title: What if Enthiran's super-robot spent ONE May afternoon in Chennai?

lines.text: What if Enthiran's super-robot spent ONE May afternoon in Chennai?
Ten A.M.: he lifts a car with one hand. Mass!
Twelve noon: his head is so hot, the neighbour makes a dosa on it.
Two P.M.: forget villains. He's fighting ME for the spot under the ceiling fan!
Uh-oh! New message: Robot overheated. Please try again in November.
I fanned him with my ears... now I'm a toasted bunny.
So, why so? An iPhone is designed for weather up to thirty-five degrees. Chennai has hit almost forty-three!
Tag the friend who melts by ten A.M.!
